sec: Cross-Service Integration - Company Checklist Sync
scen: Verify CompanyChecklist.WorkSchedulesCreated in CompanyMaster collection updates to true upon creating Company Default Work Schedule
inp: Preconditions: New or active company with CompanyChecklist.WorkSchedulesCreated == false. Body: POST /api/companies/{companyId}/worktemplates/fixed (valid Sun-Thu 09:00-17:00, no locationId)
exp:
1. Attendance DB: ERP.Attendance.WorkTemplates inserts CDWT (IsDefault=true, v1.0) and cascades N location templates.
2. Attendance DB: ERP.Attendance.WorkPlans inserts N LOCWOPL default plans.
3. Company Service DB: CompanyMaster.CompanyChecklist.WorkSchedulesCreated is updated from false to true.

sec: API Design - Scoping Parameters Consistency
scen: Verify scoping parameters (tenantId, companyId, locationId) follow uniform REST convention across all modules
inp: Compare POST /worktemplates/fixed (body contains tenantId, companyId, locationId) vs WorkPlans/Assignments (query/route only)
exp: All modules should follow unified convention: companyId in route, locationId in query, tenantId from JWT token. Body parameters should be deprecated.
remark: [Full Microservice Audit 28-Oct]: CRITICAL DEFECT PERSISTS (FAIL). Scanned entire Attendance 2 Swagger: EXACTLY 26 POST & PATCH APIs still expose 'tenantName' in their request body DTOs (WorkTemplates 10, WorkPlans 3, WorkAssignments 3, Roster 3, Policies 6, Holiday 1). Verified via Swagger UI screenshot and live schema audit. Requirement: TenantName must be pre-populated by default by backend from JWT context; it must be completely purged from all 26 request body DTOs and never sent by user.

sec: Fixed Work Template - PATCH Guard (Empty Payload)
scen: Reject PATCH request with empty body or no updatable fields
inp: PATCH /worktemplates/fixed/{id}. Request body is empty JSON object {}.
exp: HTTP 400 Bad Request. Sbp:Validation 'At least one field must be provided to update.'
remark: [Verified on Attendance 4]: FAIL (HTTP 500 CRASH). Empty body {} causes unhandled ValidationException crash.

sec: Flexi Work Template - Daily Limit Negative (> 24 Hours / 25 Hours)
scen: Reject daily work duration exceeding 24 hours (e.g. 25 hours / 1500 mins per day)
inp: POST or PATCH /worktemplates/flexi. Monday configured with isWorkingDay:true, workDurationInMinutes:1500 (25 hours).
exp: HTTP 400 Bad Request. Sbp:Validation 'Daily work duration cannot exceed 24 hours (1440 minutes).' Physical impossibility guard strictly enforced.
remark: HTTP 200 |  | Latency: 1890ms

sec: Enum Validation - FlexibleType (Daily vs Weekly vs Invalid)
scen: Validate FlexibleType enum accepted values ('Daily'=1, 'Weekly'=2) and reject invalid enum values
inp: 1. flexibleType:'Daily' (or 1) -> 200. 2. flexibleType:'Weekly' (or 2) -> 200. 3. flexibleType:'Monthly' (or 3, -1, 'Invalid') -> 400.
exp: 1 & 2: HTTP 200 OK. Persisted in MongoDB as FlexibleType:1 and FlexibleType:2. 3: HTTP 400 Bad Request 'The value 'Monthly' is not a valid FlexibleType. Allowed values are: Daily, Weekly.'
remark: [Verified on Attendance 4]: FAIL (HTTP 500 CRASH). Invalid dayEnum 8 causes unhandled ValidationException crash.

sec: Split Negative - Zero Gap Between Intervals (Contiguous Slots)
scen: Reject Split shift configuration where Interval 2 immediately follows Interval 1 with 0 gap (continuous shift configured as split)
inp: POST or PATCH /worktemplates/split. Monday configured with: Interval 1: 08:00:00 to 12:00:00; Interval 2: 12:00:00 to 16:00:00 [Gap = 0 minutes].
exp: HTTP 400 Bad Request. Sbp:Validation 'Split shift requires a minimum break duration between intervals (must be greater than 0 minutes). For continuous hours, please use Fixed shift.'
remark: [Live Verified DEFECT]: Status 500. 7-day calendar invariant failure crashes server with HTTP 500 instead of returning HTTP 400.

sec: Split Negative - Inverted Start/End Timings in an Interval
scen: Reject Split interval where EndTime is earlier than or equal to StartTime within an interval
inp: POST or PATCH /worktemplates/split. Monday Interval 1: startTime: '12:00:00', endTime: '08:00:00' (or startTime == endTime: '08:00:00' to '08:00:00').
exp: HTTP 400 Bad Request. Sbp:Validation 'EndTime must be strictly greater than StartTime for each time slot.'
remark: [Live Verified DEFECT]: Server accepted 1500m (25h/day) with HTTP 200 OK into MongoDB ERP.Attendance.WorkTemplates.

sec: Split Negative - Active Time Slots Configured on Day Off
scen: Reject Split shift payload where Friday is marked isWorkingDay:false but contains active time slots or non-zero duration
inp: POST or PATCH /worktemplates/split. Friday isWorkingDay: false, but timeSlots contains [{startTime: '08:00:00', endTime: '12:00:00'}].
exp: HTTP 400 Bad Request. Sbp:Validation 'Non-working days (Weekly Off) cannot contain time intervals. Expected noOfInterval: NotApplicable and empty timeSlots.'
remark: [Live Verified DEFECT]: Zero break gap or overlapping intervals throw unhandled HTTP 500 ValidationException crash.

sec: Split Shift Boundary - Minimum Break Duration (Gap > 0)
scen: Validate break duration between intervals in Split shift (Gap >= 15 mins passes; Gap = 0 mins or negative rejected)
inp: Monday Split: Interval 1: 08:00 to 12:00. Case A: Interval 2: 12:15 to 16:15 (15 min break). Case B: Interval 2: 12:00 to 16:00 (0 min break). Case C: Interval 2: 11:30 to 15:30 (-30 min overlap).
exp: Case A: HTTP 200/201 Success. Case B & C: HTTP 400 Bad Request: 'Split shift requires a distinct break between intervals.'
remark: [Live Verified DEFECT]: Zero break gap or overlapping intervals trigger unhandled HTTP 500 ValidationException crash instead of HTTP 400 Bad Request.

sec: PATCH Combination - Flexible to Fixed Shift Reversion
scen: Verify PATCH converting Flexible schedule back to Fixed schedule updates polymorphic _t to FixedWorkTemplate and captures shift change in ChangeLog
inp: CDWT exists as Flexible. Request: PATCH /api/companies/{companyId}/worktemplates/fixed/{id}. Payload: Valid Fixed schedule with fixedTimeSlots.
exp: HTTP 200 OK. New document created with _t: ['WorkTemplate','FixedWorkTemplate'], TemplateType: 1. FlexibleType field removed or set to null. ChangeLog records 'Work Type: Flexible -> Fixed'.
remark: [Live Verified DEFECT]: Overlapping intervals trigger unhandled HTTP 500 ValidationException crash.

sec: PATCH Combination - Split to Fixed Shift Conversion
scen: Verify PATCH converting Split Shift (Type 3) to Fixed Schedule (Type 1) collapses two intervals into single continuous interval
inp: CDWT exists as Split (v4.0). Request: PATCH /api/companies/{companyId}/worktemplates/fixed/{id}. Payload: Valid Fixed schedule (08:00 to 16:00, 8h continuous).
exp: HTTP 200 OK. New document created with _t: ['WorkTemplate','FixedWorkTemplate'], TemplateType: 1. SplitTimeSlots replaced by FixedTimeSlots. ChangeLog records 'Work Type: Split -> Fixed'.
remark: [Live Verified DEFECT]: Calendar math invariant violation triggers unhandled HTTP 500 crash.

sec: PATCH Negative - Overlapping Intervals during Split PATCH
scen: Reject Split Shift PATCH when Interval 1 and Interval 2 in the same working day overlap in time
inp: In PATCH /split/{id}, submit Monday with Interval 1: 08:00-13:00 and Interval 2: 12:00-17:00 (overlapping 12:00 to 13:00).

scen: Reject PATCH payload where totalWorkingDays + totalDaysOff does not equal exactly 7

exp: HTTP 400 Bad Request. Sbp:Validation 'Total working days and total days off must sum to exactly 7 days.'
remark: [Live Verified DEFECT]: Calendar math invariant violation during PATCH triggers unhandled HTTP 500 ValidationException crash.
